effect: The hose added drains to the beds, completing their structure and revealing the reservoir connection as the next goal.
reaction: The inspection resolved the missing step, though the earlier direct attempt was confusing.
reason: The drained beds now need their return water routed through the prepared aerating reservoir.
expectation: The bed drains will connect to the reservoir to complete the aerated return.

effect: Connecting the drained beds to the reservoir completed the shared return system and all chapter goals.
reaction: The separate depth and flow adjustments made the shared system feel practical.

mostWorthwhile.text: Building the aerating reservoir was most worthwhile: the falling return stream gave the hose connection a clear physical purpose.

leastWorthwhile.text: The failed attempt to connect the prepared reservoir directly to the lined beds was frustrating; the missing drain runs were not yet clear.

surprise.text: Inspecting the beds revealed that they needed a separate hose connection and automatically installed the drains.

arbitrary.text: The direct reservoir connection initially felt arbitrary because the reservoir was described as fitting beneath the drains before those drains had been installed. The later explanation clarified the intended sequence.

continue.text: I would continue: the irrigation details made the construction understandable, and I would be curious to see how the empty beds become productive.
